note: Starting balance for enemy species. A species' numbers are family base x tier multiplier x variant multiplier. Baseline to balance against: one player shot deals 1 damage; the primary weapon fires 8 shots per second at 120 BPM, so an un-upgraded player deals 8 damage per second in one lane. Speeds are world units per second (the ship moves at 520); radius is the final collision and visual radius in world units: the glyph's own size factor is already in it. Tune with the bot simulation; these are first guesses, not measurements.

enemyBullet.note: Slow on purpose: bullets are a pattern to read, not a reflex test. Ranged attacks fire on the beat after a one-beat telegraph.

firstSlice.note: Roster for milestone M3: twelve species from six families, with their debut. Track 1 uses Short cycles (24 bars), Track 2 Standard cycles (48 bars).

threatBudgetPerBar.note: Budget per bar during Groove, by cycle. Sections scale it as in GAME_DESIGN section 8. Since 2026-11-12 it buys threats only (hueRole hunter and special); fodder comes from the crowd block. Track 3 (Reef, Standard cycles) has no debuts of its own until milestone M5: it plays Track 2's full roster.

crowd.note: Population targets (GAME_DESIGN section 8, the crowd and the threats): enemies alive in and just around a player's frame (count.frameScale) during Groove, by Track and cycle; sections scale it. The director closes the gap to the target with fodder formations over refillBars bars. Starting values: tune with the bot (20 seeds or more) and report every change.

count.note: enemies inside a player's camera frame grown by this factor each way count toward the target; with several players the target holds for each player's frame. Replaces the 1,500 wu circle of the first build, which was five frames wide.

arrive.note: floods land along one frame edge this far outside it, rings on an ellipse this much larger than the frame, swarms this far outside its corners; the fairness rules of GAME_DESIGN section 8 still hold

stray.note: fodder outside every player's frame grown by this factor for this many bars dissolves without Shards
